findings: The amendment preserves original campaign metrics as non-protocol diagnostics and forbids their use for selection.
Corrected validation aggregation retains the pre-existing target-source-date basis, unknown source-clock timezone and fixed >=18 anchors per horizon/date.
Calibration is restricted to >=18-anchor eligible calibration dates, cannot select models and changes only frozen 0.05/0.95 interval endpoints; raw quantiles remain the primary comparison.

The two-stage freeze resolves the impossibility of knowing numeric-Sv-qualified issued IDs without opening outcomes: bind metadata candidate IDs and exact code first, then materialize numeric issuance/scoring once and preserve every exclusion.
The retrospective label, prior exposure history, 48-hour paired bootstrap, 2000 draws, 5% gate and per-horizon regression guard remain explicit.
approval_scope: Prospective interpretation and procedure only; integrate this exact ADR before any calibration or retrospective test numeric access.
conditions: Validation selection must use independently reviewed corrected metrics for all 17 final endpoints.
A separate pretest freeze must bind selected checkpoint, calibration adjustment, metadata candidate universe, reader/QC/issuance code, metrics and bootstrap hashes.
The one-time post-freeze materialization must persist actual issued/scored IDs and all abstention/QC reasons without outcome-selected repair.
